themes.evidence: Across our business, we strive to lift up the communities we’re in. We do it through our purpose, to feed and foster communities.

Our mission is to make delicious feel-good moments easy for everyone. The backbone of our Brand is, and always has been, a commitment to a set of core values that define who we are and how we run our business and restaurants.
Behind our Golden Arches is a global community of crew, farmers, suppliers, franchisees, and countless others who make up who we are as a brand.

linguistic_shift: The added content emphasizes community, inclusion, and the McFamily, reflecting a broader focus on social impact and employee well-being.
